W.note: A single-row toast that expands into a clean timeline with expected dates, carrier and tracking line, Show history and Dismiss; the whole row is the toggle, the chevron rotates, aria-expanded and aria-live are wired, and reduced motion is respected.

X.note: The richest tracker (filters, per-package progress, carrier, tracking number, stage labels, Next scan, Remove, Add form), but it opens at rest as a large panel and the tiny chevron glyphs are hard to see and hit.

Y.note: The smallest footprint and a tidy timeline with expected ETA and carrier, but it tracks only one parcel, has no next-step action, and the small grey labels and open panel covering the list on mobile weaken it.

Z.note: A compact pill that opens to a multi-package list with ETA, overdue flags, carrier, progress, next step and mark delivered, plus a labeled add form; the open panel is taller and denser than it needs to be.
